name: Mugen AI
tagline: A Notion-like workspace where AI builds apps on top of your own databases.

awards: MLH || Best Use of ElevenLabs || Wireless Earbuds

problem: People's data sits in tools that cannot become apps easily.
solution: Users create data sources by hand, AI or upload; prompts generate frontends that read and modify them, and new apps create their own data sources.
demo_moment: Team-described: generate a homework tracker from uploaded notes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH || Best Use of ElevenLabs || Wireless Earbuds” among 231 submissions.
Data and generated apps stay linked.

lessons: Generated apps are useful when they sit on real data.
